articles.title: CVE-2026-132607 - GCM authentication tag length downgrade in Amazon S3 Encryption Client for PHP
articles.description: Bulletin ID: 2026-191-AWS Publication Date: 11/19/2026 13:00 PM PST Description: We identified CVE-2026-132607, an issue in the decryption component of Amazon S3 Encryption Client for PHP in the AWS SDK for PHP. The client did not verify the length of the AES-GCM authentication tag recorded in an object's metadata. A user with read and write access to an encrypted object, who knows or can guess its plaintext, might craft a ciphertext that decrypts to plaintext of their choice of the same length.
